# First Critique — What Can Still Go Wrong

The Awtsmoos demands evidence before confidence may rise; Awtsmoos.com must not trade one missing door for a fragile surprise.

## Risks

- Shared working tree contains unrelated changes from other agents.
- `origin/main` is behind local committed `main`; a release must preserve the canonical local-main lineage without staging unrelated dirty files.
- Root static `.txt` and `.xml` MIME support must be committed with the feature or production may serve weak content types.
- Sitemap routes must be ordered before generic `/:heichel` routes.
- Sitemap generation must reuse canonical public/discoverability policy and avoid private/test Heichelos.
- Deep synchronous sitemap recursion must remain deleted.
- Numeric Road aliases must not appear as sitemap canonical URLs.
- Post and Heichel templates must consume pre-rendered semantic fragments rather than fragile nested template includes.
- Production deployment must activate an exact pushed SHA and then be verified from the public origin.

## Verification obligations

- source readback;
- isolated clean-worktree diff review;
- JS syntax/import checks;
- XML parse tests;
- relevant route tests;
- isolated server raw-HTTP acceptance;
- public production HTTP acceptance;
- final branch/origin/production SHA reconciliation.
